Question: Data Consent
Description:
Dear Teachers,


The Consent Form is attached below.
Thank you for taking the time to share your insights.


This survey is designed to better understand your experiences with Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) and Foundational Skills in the classroom, as well as your students' development in these areas. The information you provide will help strengthen teaching practices, guide interventions, and support research to improve student learning in your school.

Your responses will be linked to you as a teacher. However, all student information will remain anonymous, no student names or other identifying information will be collected, stored, or shared.

By completing this survey, you consent to the use of your responses in this and future Tilli-related surveys for the purposes of improving teaching, supporting student learning, and contributing to research on SEL and Foundational Skills.


If you are comfortable participating, please proceed with the survey. Your participation is voluntary, and you are free to stop or exit the survey at any time without any consequences.

Thank you for your valuable participation.
